list.name: Gemma-2-2B-L20-Structure-Cluster
list.description: The top 10 features forming the negative pole of the Fiedler Vector of layer 20 SAE features in Gemma-2-2B. Identified via Laplacian Eigendecomposition of the cosine similarity adjacency matrix of features. These features appear to encode rigid structure, XML/HTML, mathematics, and systematic definitions. Steering with this vector forces the model into an 'Objective/Digital' stance.
